# `outbox_event`

Transactional outbox (ARCH-07). State contract: docs/architecture/workflows/outbox-event.md.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | infrastructure |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `operational-transient`: Delivery/processing bookkeeping; purge after completion window. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | — |
| Write path | publishEvent() in the business transaction; outbox_claim() and the worker for status. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0004_outbox_idempotency (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- unique (tenant_id, topic, dedupe_key)
- processing <=> locked_by and locked_until set
- done <=> processed_at set
- transitions enforced by trigger; content immutable
- re-claim only after lease expiry
- status columns updatable by pl_worker only
